name: fitbot-monorepo
description: Root script to run FitBot full stack

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "API,ADMIN" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run start:dev --prefix fitbot-api" "npm run dev --prefix fitbot-admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix fitbot-api && npm install --prefix fitbot-admin
